title: VTT: Reading Vehicle Size and Powertrain Type from Motion Trajectory Across Unseen Car Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.22109v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vehicle size and powertrain information can enrich trajectory data for traffic analysis and simulation. We present VTT, a dataset and benchmark for identifying these attributes from motion and controller area network (CAN) signals across unseen car models. The dataset contains 9,062 drives, about 3,950 h, from 1,431 vehicles and 174 car models. It provides three footprint-based size classes, powertrain labels, and evaluation on unseen car models and unseen drivers. Using 60-s windows, we compare four sequence architectures, statistical features and physical features proposed by large language models. Training with auxiliary physical targets, data augmentation and task-specific weighting raises drive-level macro-F1 to 92.6-93.0% for battery-electric versus combustion vehicles and from 62.9% to 67.1% for size classification. On public logs from 4,061 additional drivers, the full-input model identifies powertrain correctly for 86 of 88 car

translated_title: VTT：从未见车型运动轨迹中读取车辆尺寸与动力系统类型
translated_abstract: 车辆尺寸和动力系统信息能够丰富用于交通分析与仿真的轨迹数据。我们提出了VTT，这是一个用于从未见过的车型中、基于运动信号与控制器局域网（CAN）信号识别这些属性的数据集和基准。该数据集包含来自1,431辆车、174个车型的9,062次行驶数据，总计约3,950小时。数据集提供了基于占地面积的三个尺寸类别、动力系统标签，以及针对未见车型和未见驾驶员的评估。使用60秒时间窗口，我们比较了四种序列架构、统计特征以及由大语言模型提出的物理特征。通过辅助物理目标、数据增强和任务特定加权进行训练，纯电动与内燃机车型判别的行驶级宏F1提升至92.6-93.0%，尺寸分类性能从62.9%提升至67.1%。在来自4,061名额外驾驶员的公开日志上，全输入模型在88个车型中正确识别出86个车型的动力系统。
tldr: 该论文提出VTT数据集与基准，可从未见车型的运动轨迹和CAN信号中识别车辆尺寸与动力系统类型，通过辅助物理目标、数据增强和任务加权将纯电动与燃油车判别的宏F1提升至93%、尺寸分类提升至67.1%。
en_tdlr: The paper presents VTT, a dataset and benchmark for identifying vehicle size and powertrain type from motion and CAN signals across unseen car models, achieving up to 93.0% macro-F1 for BEV vs. combustion classification and 67.1% for size classification.
